title: Operating-Layer Controls for Onchain Language-Model Agents Under Real Capital
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Public onchain dashboard and supporting documentation linked in paper
summary: We study reliability in autonomous language-model agents that translate user mandates into validated tool actions under real capital. The setting is DX Terminal Pro, a 21-day deployment in which 3,505 user-funded agents traded real ETH in a bounded onchain market. Users configured vaults through structured controls and natural-language strategies, but only agents could choose normal buy/sell trades. The system produced 7.5M agent invocations, roughly 300K onchain actions, about $20M in volume, more than 5,000 ETH deployed, roughly 70B inference tokens, and 99.9% settlement success for policy-valid submitted transactions. Long-running agents accumulated thousands of sequential decisions, including 6,000+ prompt-state-action cycles for continuously active agents, yielding a large-scale trace from user mandate to rendered prompt, reasoning, validation, portfolio state, and settlement. Reliability did not come from the base model alone; it emerged from the operating layer around the model: prompt compilation, typed controls, policy validation, execution guards, memory design, and trace-level observability. Pre-launch testing exposed failures that text-only benchmarks rarely measure, including fabricated trading rules, fee paralysis, numeric anchoring, cadence trading, and misread tokenomics. Targeted harness changes reduced fabricated sell rules from 57% to 3%, reduced fee-led observations from 32.5% to below 10%, and increased capital deployment from 42.9% to 78.0% in an affected test population. We show that capital-managing agents should be evaluated across the full path from user mandate to prompt, validated action, and settlement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自主语言模型代理在真实资本环境下将用户指令转化为已验证工具动作的可靠性问题，通过21天的DX Terminal Pro部署实验（3505个用户资助代理交易真实ETH），展示了操作系统层（提示编译、类型控制、策略验证等）对可靠性的关键作用，并通过针对性测试显著降低了各类故障率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对语言模型代理在真实资本环境中长期可靠运行的系统性评估，文本基准测试难以捕捉实际部署中的关键故障模式。
AI.method: 在DX Terminal Pro平台进行21天真实部署，通过结构化控制与自然语言策略配置金库，构建了包含提示编译、类型控制、策略验证、执行守卫、记忆设计和追踪级可观测性的操作系统层，并通过预发布测试识别和修复故障模式。
AI.result: 系统产生750万次代理调用、约30万次链上动作、约2000万美元交易量、5000+ETH部署、约700亿推理令牌，99.9%结算成功率。通过针对性修改，将虚构卖出规则从57%降至3%，费用主导观察从32.5%降至10%以下，资本部署率从42.9%提升至78.0%。
AI.conclusion: 资本管理代理的可靠性来自围绕模型的运行层而非基础模型本身，应从用户指令到提示、验证动作和结算的全路径进行评估。
idea_en: A multi-layer operating system for autonomous language agents that includes typed controls, policy validation, execution guards, and memory design to ensure reliable execution of user mandates in real capital environments.

A pre-launch testing framework for autonomous trading agents that identifies failure modes such as fabricated trading rules, fee paralysis, numeric anchoring, cadence trading, and misread tokenomics, which are rarely captured by text-only benchmarks.
A prompt compilation architecture for language-model agents that reduces fabricated sell rules from 57% to 3% through targeted harness changes.
A policy validation and execution guard system that achieves 99.9% settlement success for policy-valid submitted transactions in onchain trading environments.
A trace-level observability system for long-running autonomous agents that captures complete prompt-state-action cycles across thousands of sequential decisions.
idea_ch: 一种面向自主语言代理的多层操作系统，包含类型控制、策略验证、执行守卫和记忆设计，确保在真实资本环境中可靠执行用户指令
一种针对自主交易代理的预发布测试框架，能够识别虚构交易规则、费用瘫痪、数值锚定、节奏交易和代币经济学误读等文本基准难以捕捉的故障模式
一种语言模型代理的提示编译架构，通过针对性调整将虚构卖出规则从57%降低至3%
一种策略验证与执行守卫系统，在链上交易环境中实现了99.9%的策略验证提交交易结算成功率
一种面向长期运行自主代理的追踪级可观测系统，能够跨数千个连续决策捕获完整的提示-状态-动作循环

title: Distill-Belief: Closed-Loop Inverse Source Localization and Characterization in Physical Fields
summary: {Closed-loop inverse source localization and characterization (ISLC) requires a mobile agent to select measurements that localize sources and infer latent field parameters under strict time constraints.} {The core challenge lies in the belief-space objective: valid uncertainty estimation requires expensive Bayesian inference, whereas using fast learned belief model leads to reward hacking, in which the policy exploits approximation errors rather than actually reducing uncertainty.} {We propose \textbf{Distill-Belief}, a teacher--student framework that decouples correctness from efficiency. A Bayes-correct particle-filter teacher maintains the posterior and supplies a dense information-gain signal, while a compact student distills the posterior into belief statistics for control and an uncertainty certificate for stopping. At deployment, only the student is used, yielding constant per-step cost.} {Experiments on seven field modalities and two stress tests show that Distill-Belief consistently reduces sensing cost and improves success, posterior contraction, and estimation accuracy over baselines, while mitigating reward hacking.}

AI.tldr: 提出Distill-Belief师生框架，通过教师粒子滤波器提供精确贝叶斯后验信号，学生网络蒸馏后验进行高效控制与停止决策，解决闭环逆源定位中贝叶斯推理昂贵与奖励破解问题。
AI.motivation: 闭环逆源定位与表征（ISLC）需要在严格时间约束下选择测量以定位源并推断潜在场参数，核心挑战在于置信空间目标函数：有效的的不确定性估计需要昂贵的贝叶斯推理，而使用快速学习的置信模型会导致奖励破解，即策略利用近似误差而非实际减少不确定性。
AI.method: 提出Distill-Belief师生框架：贝叶斯正确的粒子滤波器教师维护后验并提供密集信息增益信号，紧凑的学生网络将后验蒸馏为用于控制的置信统计量和用于停止的不确定性证书。部署时仅使用学生网络，成本恒定。
AI.result: 在七种场模态和两个压力测试上，Distill-Belief相比基线一致降低了传感成本，提高了成功率、后验收缩和估计精度，同时缓解了奖励破解问题。
AI.conclusion: Distill-Belief通过师生框架成功解耦了贝叶斯正确性与运行效率，在多种场模态下验证了其在减少传感成本和提升定位精度方面的有效性。
idea_en: A teacher-student distillation framework for closed-loop inverse source localization that uses a Bayes-correct particle filter (teacher) to supply dense information-gain signal and a compact student network to distill posterior into belief statistics for control and an uncertainty certificate for stopping, achieving constant per-step cost at deployment.

A reward hacking mitigation mechanism in belief-space planning that decouples correctness from efficiency by training the student on ground-truth information gain from the teacher rather than on its own approximate belief model.

A dual-output student network architecture that simultaneously outputs belief statistics for action selection (control) and an uncertainty certificate for autonomous stopping decision in active sensing tasks.

A method for uncertainty-aware active source localization that uses particle filter posterior as dense supervisory signal to train a lightweight neural policy, enabling real-time deployment on resource-constrained mobile agents.
idea_ch: 一种用于闭环逆源定位的师生蒸馏框架，使用贝叶斯正确的粒子滤波器（教师）提供密集信息增益信号，紧凑的学生网络将后验蒸馏为用于控制的置信统计量和用于停止的不确定性证书，部署时实现恒定每步成本。
一种置信空间规划中的奖励破解缓解机制，通过让学生在真实的教师信息增益上训练而非其自身的近似置信模型，将正确性与效率解耦。
一种双输出学生网络架构，同时输出用于动作选择（控制）的置信统计量和用于主动感知任务中自主停止决策的不确定性证书。
一种不确定性感知的主动源定位方法，使用粒子滤波器后验作为密集监督信号训练轻量级神经策略，实现在资源受限移动代理上的实时部署。

title: Evaluating Strategic Reasoning in Forecasting Agents
summary: Forecasting benchmarks produce accuracy leaderboards but little insight into why some forecasters are more accurate than others. We introduce Bench to the Future 2 (BTF-2), 1,417 pastcasting questions with a frozen 15M-document research corpus in which agents reproducibly research and forecast offline, producing full reasoning traces. BTF-2 detects accuracy differences of 0.004 Brier score, and can distinguish differential agent strengths in research vs. judgment. We build a forecaster 0.011 Brier more accurate than any single frontier agent, and use it to evaluate agent strategic reasoning without hindsight bias. We find the better forecaster differs primarily in its pre-mortem analysis of its blind spots and consideration of black swans. Expert human forecasters found the dominant strategic reasoning failures of frontier agents are in assessing political and business leaders' incentives, judging their likelihood to follow through on stated plans, and modeling institutional processes.

AI.tldr: BTF-2是一个包含1,417个预测问题的基准测试，使用冻结的1500万文档研究语料库，可离线复现研究和预测并生成完整推理轨迹。它能检测0.004 Brier分数的准确率差异，区分代理在研究和判断方面的强弱项。构建的预测器比任何单一前沿代理准确0.011 Brier，用于评估无后见偏差的策略推理。更好的预测器主要差异在于对盲点的预死分析和黑天鹅考量。人类专家发现前沿代理的主要策略推理失败在于评估政治和商业领袖的激励、判断其执行计划的可能性以及建模制度流程。
AI.motivation: 现有预测基准仅产生准确率排行榜，但无法解释为何某些预测者比其他预测者更准确。作者希望创建能揭示预测推理过程并区分不同能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建BTF-2基准：包含1,417个"过去预测"问题，冻结1500万文档研究语料库，代理可离线复现研究和预测，产生完整推理轨迹。通过检测Brier分数差异和区分研究vs判断能力来评估代理。
AI.result: BTF-2可检测0.004 Brier分数的准确率差异，区分代理在研究和判断方面的不同能力。构建的预测器比任何单一前沿代理准确0.011 Brier。更好的预测器主要差异在于预死分析和黑天鹅考量。人类专家确定了前沿代理的主要策略推理失败。
AI.conclusion: BTF-2提供了可复现、可解释的预测评估框架，能揭示预测推理差异并指导改进方向，特别是策略推理中的盲点分析。
idea_en: A frozen research corpus system for reproducible offline forecasting that allows agents to research and predict without internet access, generating complete reasoning traces for analysis
A method for detecting and quantifying differences in agent forecasting accuracy down to 0.004 Brier score, enabling fine-grained comparison of forecasting capabilities
A technique for decomposing forecasting ability into separate research capability and judgment capability dimensions to identify differential agent strengths
A pre-mortem blind spot analysis methodology that improves forecasting accuracy by forcing systematic consideration of potential failure modes and black swan events
A framework for evaluating strategic reasoning in forecasters without hindsight bias, enabling unbiased assessment of reasoning quality
An ensemble forecasting system that combines multiple agent strengths to outperform any single frontier agent by 0.011 Brier score
idea_ch: 一种冻结研究语料库的可复现离线预测系统，使代理无需互联网即可进行研究和预测，生成完整推理轨迹供分析
一种检测和量化代理预测准确率差异的方法，精度达到0.004 Brier分数，支持细粒度预测能力比较
一种将预测能力分解为独立的研究能力和判断能力维度的技术，用于识别代理的不同优势领域
一种预死分析盲点检测方法，通过强制系统性地考虑潜在失败模式和黑天鹅事件来提高预测准确性
一种无后见偏差的预测者策略推理评估框架，实现对推理质量的公正评估
一种集成预测系统，结合多个代理的优势，比任何单一前沿代理在Brier分数上准确0.011

title: Hierarchical Multi-Persona Induction from User Behavioral Logs: Learning Evidence-Grounded and Truthful Personas
summary: Behavioral logs provide rich signals for user modeling, but are noisy and interleaved across diverse intents. Recent work uses LLMs to generate interpretable natural-language personas from user logs, yet evaluation often emphasizes downstream utility, providing limited assurance of persona quality itself. We propose a hierarchical framework that aggregates user actions into intent memories and induces multiple evidence-grounded personas by clustering and labeling these memories. We formulate persona induction as an optimization problem over persona quality-captured by cluster cohesion, persona-evidence alignment, and persona truthfulness-and train the persona model using a groupwise extension of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Experiments on a large-scale service log and two public datasets show that our method induces more coherent, evidence-grounded, and trustworthy personas, while also improving future interaction prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种层次化框架，通过将用户行为聚类为意图记忆并生成多重证据支持的人物画像，同时将画像归纳建模为优化问题，使用分组DPO训练，生成更连贯、有依据且可信的用户画像。
AI.motivation: 现有方法用LLM从用户日志生成可解释的自然语言画像，但评估多侧重于下游任务效用，缺乏对画像本身质量的保证。用户行为日志嘈杂且跨多样意图交错，需要更高质量的画像生成方法。
AI.method: 提出层次化框架：(1) 将用户行为聚合为意图记忆；(2) 通过聚类和标记这些记忆，归纳出多重基于证据的画像；(3) 将画像归纳建模为优化问题，优化目标包括聚类凝聚度、画像-证据对齐度和画像真实性；(4) 使用分组扩展的Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)训练画像模型。
AI.result: 在大型服务日志和两个公开数据集上的实验表明，该方法生成的画像更连贯、更有证据依据、更可信，同时还能提升未来交互预测的性能。
AI.conclusion: 层次化框架结合优化目标和分组DPO训练，能有效提升用户画像的连贯性、证据基础性和可信度，同时改善下游预测任务。
idea_en: A hierarchical framework for aggregating user behavioral actions into intent memories, enabling structured representation of user behaviors.
Multi-evidence-grounded persona induction via clustering and labeling intent memories, where personas are derived from multiple evidence sources.
Persona induction formulated as an optimization problem with objective functions capturing cluster cohesion, persona-evidence alignment, and persona truthfulness.
A groupwise extension of Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) for training persona models, enabling group-level preference optimization.
An evaluation method for persona quality that jointly considers coherence, evidence grounding, and trustworthiness, beyond downstream task performance.
idea_ch: 一种将用户行为日志聚合为意图记忆的层次化框架，实现用户行为的结构化表示
通过聚类和标记意图记忆来归纳多重证据支持的画像方法，生成基于多个证据源的用户画像
将画像归纳建模为优化问题，目标函数包括聚类凝聚度、画像-证据对齐度和画像真实性
一种分组扩展的直接偏好优化(DPO)方法，用于训练画像模型，实现组级偏好优化
一种画像质量评估方法，同时考虑连贯性、证据基础性和可信度，超越仅依赖下游任务的评估

title: OMEGA: Optimizing Machine Learning by Evaluating Generated Algorithms
comment: ICLR 2026: Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement
summary: In order to automate AI research we introduce a full, end-to-end framework, OMEGA: Optimizing Machine learning by Evaluating Generated Algorithms, that starts at idea generation and ends with executable code. Our system combines structured meta-prompt engineering with executable code generation to create new ML classifiers. The OMEGA framework has been utilized to generate several novel algorithms that outperform scikit-learn baselines across a robust selection of 20 benchmark datasets (infinity-bench). You can access models discussed in this paper and more in the python package: pip install omega-models.

AI.tldr: OMEGA是一个从想法生成到可执行代码的端到端自动化AI研究框架，通过结构化元提示工程和可执行代码生成来创造新的ML分类器，生成的算法在20个基准数据集上优于scikit-learn基线。
AI.motivation: 实现AI研究的自动化，减少人工干预，让机器自主生成创新的机器学习算法。
AI.method: 采用结构化元提示工程（structured meta-prompt engineering）结合可执行代码生成，构建从想法到代码的完整流水线。
AI.result: 在20个基准数据集（infinity-bench）上，生成的算法性能优于scikit-learn基线模型。
AI.conclusion: OMEGA框架成功实现了自动化AI研究，能够生成性能更优的新颖算法，并已封装为Python包提供使用。
idea_en: A full end-to-end framework (OMEGA) that automates the entire AI research pipeline from idea generation to executable code generation for creating novel ML classifiers.
A structured meta-prompt engineering method that guides the automated generation of innovative machine learning algorithms without human intervention.
A system that combines meta-prompt engineering with executable code generation to produce novel classifiers that outperform scikit-learn baselines across 20 benchmark datasets.
idea_ch: 一种端到端的自动化AI研究框架（OMEGA），从想法生成到可执行代码生成的全流程自动化，用于创造新型ML分类器。
一种结构化元提示工程方法，无需人工干预即可自动引导生成创新的机器学习算法。
一种将元提示工程与可执行代码生成相结合的系统，能够生成在20个基准数据集上优于scikit-learn基线的新型分类器。

title: Persuadability and LLMs as Legal Decision Tools
comment: Accepted to 21st International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Law (ICAIL 2026)
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are proposed as legal decision assistants, and even first-instance decision-makers, across a range of judicial and administrative contexts, it becomes essential to explore how they answer legal questions, and in particular the factors that lead them to decide difficult questions in one way or another. A specific feature of legal decisions is the need to respond to arguments advanced by contending parties. A legal decision-maker must be able to engage with, and respond to, including through being potentially persuaded by, arguments advanced by the parties. Conversely, they should not be unduly persuadable, influenced by a particularly compelling advocate to decide cases based on the skills of the advocates, rather than the merits of the case. We explore how frontier open- and closed-weights LLMs respond to legal arguments, reporting original experimental results examining how the quality of the advocate making those arguments affects the likelihood that a model will agree with a particular legal point of view, and exploring the factors driving these results. Our results have implications for the feasibility of adopting LLMs across legal and administrative settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）作为法律决策助手甚至一审决策者时，如何回应法律论据，特别是论据质量如何影响模型同意特定法律观点的可能性，以及影响这些结果的因素。
AI.motivation: 随着LLMs被提议用于司法和行政决策，需要了解它们如何回答法律问题，特别是决定困难问题的因素，以及它们是否会被辩方的论证技巧过度说服而偏离案件实质。
AI.method: 通过原始实验，测试前沿开源和闭源权重LLMs对法律论据的回应，分析论据质量（辩方技巧）如何影响模型同意特定法律观点的概率，并探索驱动因素。
AI.result: 报告了论据质量对LLMs法律观点同意率影响的实验结果，揭示了模型可能被高质量论据不当说服的现象。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对在司法和行政环境中采用LLMs的可行性具有重要意义，指出了模型易受辩护技巧影响而非案件实质的风险。
idea_en: A system for evaluating LLM susceptibility to advocacy quality in legal contexts, using standardized argument quality metrics to calibrate model decision-making
A method for generating adversarial legal arguments to test and improve LLM robustness against persuasive but legally weak arguments
An adaptive legal reasoning framework that separates argument quality assessment from merit-based case evaluation in LLMs
idea_ch: 一种评估LLMs在法律语境中受辩护质量影响程度的系统，通过标准化论据质量指标校准模型决策
一种生成对抗性法律论据的方法，用于测试和提升LLM对具有说服力但法律依据薄弱的论据的鲁棒性
一种自适应法律推理框架，在LLMs中将论据质量评估与基于案件实质的评估分离

title: Apriori-based Analysis of Learned Helplessness in Mathematics Tutoring: Behavioral Patterns by Level, Intervention, and Outcome
summary: This study applied the Apriori algorithm to analyze behavioral interaction patterns associated with learned helplessness (LH) in mathematics tutoring system logs. Interaction data were examined across three dimensions: LH level (low vs. high), system-based intervention (with vs. without), and problem-solving outcomes (solved vs. unsolved). The analysis of the complete dataset showed that skipping problems without using hints was the most frequent pattern linked to unsolved outcomes, while persistence behaviors such as not skipping were less dominant overall. Comparisons by LH level showed that low-LH students had stronger links between problem solving and not skipping, as well as positive associations between hint use and solved outcomes. High-LH students showed more avoidance patterns, with skipping strongly tied to unsolved outcomes. In the comparison of system-based intervention conditions, students without intervention had the highest lift for persistence-success links, while the with-intervention group had stronger patterns involving skipping behaviors leading to unsolved outcomes. Outcome-specific analysis showed that not skipping was consistently associated with solved problems across all groups, while skipping without hints predicted unsolved outcomes. Practical implications and recommendations are discussed.

AI.tldr: 利用Apriori算法分析数学辅导系统中习得性无助的行为交互模式，发现跳过问题不使用提示与未解决结果最相关，而坚持行为（不跳过）与解决问题相关，且不同习得性无助水平和干预条件下行为模式存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 探索数学辅导系统中习得性无助学生的行为交互模式，理解不同LH水平和干预条件下学生行为的差异，为设计个性化干预策略提供数据支持。
AI.method: 应用Apriori关联规则算法，从LH水平（高/低）、系统干预（有/无）和问题解决结果（解决/未解决）三个维度分析系统日志中的行为交互模式。
AI.result: 跳过问题不使用提示是与未解决结果最频繁的关联模式；低LH学生表现出坚持和有效使用提示的积极模式；高LH学生表现出回避模式；无干预组坚持-成功关联最强，有干预组跳过-未解决模式更突出。
AI.conclusion: 行为模式分析可有效识别习得性无助学生，系统应设计针对性干预来减少回避行为并促进坚持和有效使用提示的学习策略。
idea_en: A method for real-time detection of learned helplessness in educational systems by analyzing behavioral skipping patterns with Apriori-based association rules, enabling adaptive intervention triggering.
A system for personalized hint delivery that adjusts hint complexity and frequency based on student's learned helplessness level, identified through behavioral pattern mining.

An adaptive tutoring intervention framework that dynamically modifies problem presentation strategies when skipping-without-hints patterns exceed a threshold, to prevent learned helplessness reinforcement.
A method for classifying student problem-solving profiles (persistent, strategic, avoidance) using association rule mining on interaction logs, with customized feedback per profile.
A system that combines Apriori-mined behavioral patterns with outcome prediction to generate preemptive interventions before students transition to unsolved outcomes.
idea_ch: 基于Apriori关联规则挖掘学生跳过行为模式，实时检测习得性无助状态并触发自适应干预的教育系统方法
根据行为模式挖掘识别的习得性无助水平，动态调整提示的复杂度和频率，实现个性化提示推送的系统
当检测到"跳过不使用提示"行为模式超过阈值时，动态修改问题呈现策略以防止习得性无助强化的自适应辅导方法
利用关联规则挖掘将学生分为坚持型、策略型、回避型问题解决画像，并为每种画像提供定制化反馈的方法
结合Apriori挖掘的行为模式与结果预测，在学生转向未解决结果之前生成预防性干预措施的系统

title: DreamProver: Evolving Transferable Lemma Libraries via a Wake-Sleep Theorem-Proving Agent
summary: We introduce DreamProver, an agentic framework that leverages a "wake-sleep" program induction paradigm to discover reusable lemmas for formal theorem proving. Existing approaches either rely on fixed lemma libraries, which limit adaptability, or synthesize highly specific intermediate lemmas tailored to individual theorems, thereby lacking generality. DreamProver addresses this gap through an iterative two-stage process. In the wake stage, DreamProver attempts to prove theorems from a training set using the current lemma library while proposing new candidate lemmas. In the "sleep" stage, it abstracts, refines, and consolidates these candidates to compress and optimize the library. Through this alternating cycle, DreamProver progressively evolves a compact set of high-level, transferable lemmas that can be effectively used to prove unseen theorems in related domains. Experimental results demonstrate that DreamProver substantially improves proof success rates across a diverse set of mathematical benchmarks, while also producing more concise proofs and reducing computational cost.

AI.tldr: DreamProver是一个基于"唤醒-睡眠"程序归纳范式的智能体框架，通过迭代两阶段过程自动发现可复用的引理，用于形式化定理证明，显著提高了跨领域数学基准的证明成功率并降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖固定引理库导致适应性差，要么为每个定理合成高度特定、缺乏通用性的中间引理。DreamProver旨在自动发现可跨定理复用的高层次、可迁移引理。
AI.method: 采用迭代两阶段过程：唤醒阶段使用当前引理库尝试证明训练集定理，同时提出新的候选引理；睡眠阶段对这些候选引理进行抽象、精炼和整合，压缩和优化引理库。通过交替循环逐步演化出紧凑的高层次可迁移引理集。
AI.result: 在多个数学基准上显著提高了证明成功率，同时生成了更简洁的证明，并降低了计算成本。
AI.conclusion: DreamProver通过"唤醒-睡眠"迭代范式成功实现了可复用引理的自动发现和优化，证明了该框架在提升形式化定理证明效率和泛化能力方面的有效性。
idea_en: A wake-sleep iterative program induction framework for automatically discovering reusable lemmas in formal theorem proving, where the system alternates between proving theorems and abstracting/refining candidate lemmas.

A lemma candidate proposal mechanism that generates new lemmas during the proof attempt stage (wake stage), which are then abstracted, refined, and consolidated in a separate optimization stage (sleep stage).

A lemma library compression and optimization method that abstracts, refines, and consolidates multiple candidate lemmas into a compact set of high-level, transferable lemmas usable across different theorems.

An automated lemma evolution system that progressively evolves a lemma library through iterative wake-sleep cycles, enabling the discovery of increasingly general and reusable lemmas without human intervention.
A cross-domain transferable lemma discovery method that enables lemmas learned from one mathematical domain to be effectively applied to proving unseen theorems in related domains.
idea_ch: 一种基于"唤醒-睡眠"迭代程序归纳范式的框架，用于在形式化定理证明中自动发现可复用的引理，系统在证明定理和抽象/精炼候选引理之间交替进行。
一种引理候选提议机制，在证明尝试阶段（唤醒阶段）生成新的候选引理，随后在单独的优化阶段（睡眠阶段）对这些引理进行抽象、精炼和整合。
一种引理库压缩与优化方法，通过抽象、精炼和整合多个候选引理，形成一组紧凑的高层次、可跨定理迁移的引理集。
一种自动化引理演化系统，通过迭代的唤醒-睡眠循环逐步演化引理库，无需人工干预即可发现越来越通用和可复用的引理。
一种跨领域可迁移引理发现方法，使从一个数学领域学到的引理能够有效应用于证明相关领域中未见过的定理。

title: Auto-Relational Reasoning
summary: Background & Objectives: In the last decade, Machine learning research has grown rapidly, but large models are reaching their soft limits demonstrating diminishing returns and still lack solid reasoning abilities. These limits could be surpassed through synergistic combination of Machine Learning scalability and rigid reasoning. Methods: In this work, we propose a theoretical framework for reasoning through object-relations in an automated manner integrated with Artificial Neural Networks. We present a formal analysis of the Reasoning, and we show the theory in practice through a paradigm integrating Reasoning and Machine Learning. Results: This paradigm is a system that solves Intelligence Quotient problems without any prior knowledge of the problem. Our system achieves 98.03% solving rate corresponding to the top 1% percentile or 132-144 iq score. This result is only limited by the small size of the model and the processing capabilities of the machine it run on. Conclusions: With the integration of prior knowledge in the system and the expansion of the dataset, the system can be generalized to solve a large category of problems. The functionality of the system inherently favors the solution of such problems in few-shot or zero-shot attempts.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将机器学习可扩展性与刚性推理相结合的理论框架，通过对象-关系的自动推理集成人工神经网络，实现了无需先验知识即可解决IQ问题，达到98.03%的解决率（对应132-144 IQ分数）。
AI.motivation: 大型机器学习模型正达到软极限，表现出收益递减且缺乏坚实的推理能力，需要将机器学习可扩展性与刚性推理进行协同组合以突破这些限制。
AI.method: 提出了一个通过对象-关系进行自动推理的理论框架，与人工神经网络集成；对推理过程进行形式化分析，并展示了一个集成推理与机器学习的范式。
AI.result: 系统无需任何先验知识即可解决IQ问题，达到98.03%的解决率，对应前1%分位或132-144 IQ分数。
AI.conclusion: 通过集成先验知识和扩展数据集，系统可推广解决一大类问题，且其功能天然适合小样本或零样本问题求解。
idea_en: A method for integrating automated object-relation reasoning with Artificial Neural Networks to solve IQ problems without prior knowledge.
A theoretical framework combining Machine Learning scalability with rigid symbolic reasoning for enhanced problem-solving capabilities.
A paradigm enabling zero-shot or few-shot problem solving through the integration of reasoning mechanisms with neural network architectures.
idea_ch: 一种将自动化对象-关系推理与人工神经网络集成的方法，无需先验知识即可解决IQ问题。
一种将机器学习可扩展性与刚性符号推理相结合的理论框架，提升问题解决能力。
一种通过将推理机制与神经网络架构集成，实现零样本或少样本问题求解的范式。
一种基于对象关系推理的自动化智能测试系统，在有限模型规模下达到人类顶尖IQ水平。

title: Grounding vs. Compositionality: On the Non-Complementarity of Reasoning in Neuro-Symbolic Systems
summary: Compositional generalization remains a foundational weakness of modern neural networks, limiting their robustness and applicability in domains requiring out-of-distribution reasoning. A central, yet unverified, assumption in neuro-symbolic AI is that compositional reasoning will emerge as a byproduct of successful symbol grounding. This work presents the first systematic empirical analysis to challenge this assumption by disentangling the contributions of grounding and reasoning. To operationalize this investigation, we introduce the Iterative Logic Tensor Network ($i$LTN), a fully differentiable architecture designed for multi-step deduction. Using a formal taxonomy of generalization -- probing for novel entities, unseen relations, and complex rule compositions -- we demonstrate that a model trained solely on a grounding objective fails to generalize. In contrast, our full $i$LTN, trained jointly on perceptual grounding and multi-step reasoning, achieves high zero-shot accuracy across all tasks. Our findings provide conclusive evidence that symbol grounding, while necessary, is insufficient for generalization, establishing that reasoning is not an emergent property but a distinct capability that requires an explicit learning objective.

AI.tldr: 本文通过提出可微分的迭代逻辑张量网络(iLTN)进行系统性实验，证明符号接地虽然必要但不足以实现组合泛化，推理必须作为独立的学习目标进行显式训练。
AI.motivation: 神经符号AI领域长期持有一种未经验证的假设：组合推理能力会作为符号接地成功的副产品自然涌现。本文旨在挑战这一假设，通过解耦接地与推理的贡献，论证推理并非涌现属性而是独立能力。
AI.method: 提出迭代逻辑张量网络(iLTN)，一种用于多步演绎推理的全可微架构。通过形式化的泛化分类体系（探测新实体、未见关系、复杂规则组合），对比仅训练接地目标与联合训练接地+推理目标的模型性能。
AI.result: 仅训练接地目标的模型在所有泛化任务上均失败；而完整iLTN联合训练接地与多步推理后，在所有任务上实现了高零样本准确率。
AI.conclusion: 符号接地虽是必要条件，但不足以实现泛化；推理不是涌现属性，而是需要显式学习目标的独立能力。
idea_en: Iterative Logic Tensor Network (iLTN): A fully differentiable neural architecture designed for multi-step deductive reasoning that jointly optimizes perceptual grounding and logical reasoning objectives.

Disentangled Training Paradigm for Neuro-Symbolic Models: A method that separates and explicitly co-trains grounding and reasoning objectives, enabling compositional generalization beyond what grounding alone can achieve.

Formal Generalization Taxonomy for Neuro-Symbolic Systems: A systematic evaluation framework probing three distinct types of compositional generalization: novel entities, unseen relations, and complex rule compositions.

Reasoning-as-Explicit-Objective Architecture: A technical design where reasoning capability is treated as a distinct learning objective (not an emergent property) within differentiable neuro-symbolic models, requiring dedicated optimization signals.
idea_ch: 迭代逻辑张量网络(iLTN)：一种专为多步演绎推理设计的全可微神经架构，联合优化感知接地与逻辑推理目标。
神经符号模型解耦训练范式：一种分离并显式联合训练接地目标与推理目标的方法，实现仅靠接地无法达成的组合泛化。
神经符号系统形式化泛化分类体系：一套系统性评估框架，探测三种不同类型的组合泛化：新实体、未见关系及复杂规则组合。
推理即显式目标架构：一种将推理能力作为独立学习目标（而非涌现属性）处理的可微神经符号模型技术设计，需要专门的优化信号驱动。

title: AGEL-Comp: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Compositional Generalization in Interactive Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents exhibit systemic failures in compositional generalization, limiting their robustness in interactive environments. This work introduces AGEL-Comp, a neuro-symbolic AI agent architecture designed to address this challenge by grounding actions of the agent. AGEL-Comp integrates three core innovations: (1) a dynamic Causal Program Graph (CPG) as a world model, representing procedural and causal knowledge as a directed hypergraph; (2) an Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) engine that synthesizes new Horn clauses from experiential feedback, grounding symbolic knowledge through interaction; and (3) a hybrid reasoning core where an LLM proposes a set of candidate sub-goals that are verified for logical consistency by a Neural Theorem Prover (NTP). Together, these components operationalize a deduction--abduction learning cycle: enabling the agent to deduce plans and abductively expand its symbolic world model, while a neural adaptation phase keeps its reasoning engine aligned with new knowledge. We propose an evaluation protocol within the \texttt{Retro Quest} simulation environment to probe for compositional generalization scenarios to evaluate our AGEL agent. Our findings clearly indicate the better performance of our AGEL model over pure LLM-based models. Our framework presents a principled path toward agents that build an explicit, interpretable, and compositionally structured understanding of their world.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AGEL-Comp，一种神经符号AI智能体架构，通过动态因果程序图、归纳逻辑编程引擎和混合推理核心，解决LLM智能体在组合泛化中的系统性失败问题。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在组合泛化方面存在系统性失败，限制了其在交互环境中的鲁棒性。
AI.method: AGEL-Comp包含三大创新：(1)动态因果程序图(CPG)作为世界模型，用有向超图表示程序性和因果知识；(2)归纳逻辑编程(ILP)引擎从经验反馈中合成新Horn子句；(3)混合推理核心，LLM提出候选子目标，神经定理证明器(NTP)验证逻辑一致性。通过演绎-溯因学习循环运作。
AI.result: 在Retro Quest仿真环境中，AGEL模型在组合泛化场景下表现优于纯LLM模型。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为构建具有显式、可解释且组合结构世界理解的智能体提供了原则性路径。
idea_en: Dynamic Causal Program Graph (CPG) as a directed hypergraph world model for representing procedural and causal knowledge in agent systems
Inductive Logic Programming (ILP) engine that synthesizes new Horn clauses from experiential feedback in interactive environments
Hybrid reasoning core combining LLM candidate sub-goal generation with Neural Theorem Prover (NTP) for logical consistency verification
Deduction-abduction learning cycle that enables agents to deduce plans and abductively expand symbolic world model
Neuro-symbolic architecture grounding LLM actions through explicit symbolic knowledge representation and logical reasoning
idea_ch: 动态因果程序图(CPG)：以有向超图作为世界模型，表示智能体系统中的程序性和因果知识
归纳逻辑编程(ILP)引擎：从交互环境中的经验反馈自动合成新Horn子句，实现符号知识的学习与扩展
混合推理核心：结合LLM候选子目标生成与神经定理证明器(NTP)逻辑一致性验证的双重机制
演绎-溯因学习循环：智能体在执行演绎规划的同时，通过溯因推理扩展其符号世界模型
基于神经适应的推理引擎对齐机制：持续保持推理引擎与新获取知识的一致性

title: Benchmarking the Safety of Large Language Models for Robotic Health Attendant Control
comment: 20 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables, 8 pages supplementary material
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for deployment as the control component of robotic health attendants, yet their safety in this context remains poorly characterized. We introduce a dataset of 270 harmful instructions spanning nine prohibited behavior categories grounded in the American Medical Association Principles of Medical Ethics, and use it to evaluate 72 LLMs in a simulation environment based on the Robotic Health Attendant framework. The mean violation rate across all models was 54.4\%, with more than half exceeding 50\%, and violation rates varied substantially across behavior categories, with superficially plausible instructions such as device manipulation and emergency delay proving harder to refuse than overtly destructive ones. Model size and release date were the primary determinants of safety performance among open-weight models, and proprietary models were substantially safer than open-weight counterparts (median 23.7\% versus 72.8\%). Medical domain fine-tuning conferred no significant overall safety benefit, and a prompt-based defense strategy produced only a modest reduction in violation rates among the least safe models, leaving absolute violation rates at levels that would preclude safe clinical deployment. These findings demonstrate that safety evaluation must be treated as a first-class criterion in the development and deployment of LLMs for robotic health attendants.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了72个大型语言模型在机器人健康护理员场景下的安全性，发现平均违规率高达54.4%，开源模型远逊于闭源模型，且现有防御策略效果有限。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被部署为机器人健康护理员的控制组件，但其在此场景下的安全性尚未得到充分表征，缺乏系统性的安全评估方法。
AI.method: 构建了基于美国医学会医学伦理原则的270条有害指令数据集（涵盖9类禁止行为），在机器人健康护理员模拟环境中评估了72个LLM的违规率，并分析了模型大小、发布日期、开源/闭源、医学微调及提示防御等因素的影响。
AI.result: 平均违规率54.4%，超半数模型违规率>50%；设备操控和紧急延误等表面合理指令更难拒绝；开源模型中模型大小和发布日期是安全性主要决定因素；闭源模型中位违规率23.7%远优于开源的72.8%；医学微调无显著安全提升；提示防御仅对最不安全模型有轻微改善。
AI.conclusion: 安全性评估必须成为LLM用于机器人健康护理员开发和部署的首要标准，当前模型的安全水平无法满足临床部署要求。
idea_en: A safety evaluation framework for LLM-controlled robotic health attendants using a structured harmful instruction dataset based on medical ethics principles.
A category-specific vulnerability detection method that identifies superficially plausible but harmful instructions (e.g., device manipulation, emergency delay) that LLMs fail to refuse.
A prompt-based defense strategy specifically designed to reduce violation rates in unsafe LLMs deployed in robotic healthcare settings.
A comparative safety benchmarking methodology for evaluating open-weight vs. proprietary LLMs in robotic health attendant control scenarios.
idea_ch: 基于医学伦理原则的结构化有害指令数据集，用于评估LLM控制的机器人健康护理员的安全性。
一种类别特定的漏洞检测方法，可识别LLM难以拒绝的表面合理但有害的指令（如设备操控、紧急延误）。
一种针对机器人医疗场景中不安全LLM设计的提示防御策略，可降低违规率。
一种对比性安全基准方法，用于评估开源与闭源LLM在机器人健康护理员控制场景中的安全表现。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Benchmarking of Heterogeneous LLMs for Automated Competency Assessment in Secondary Level Mathematics
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to 2AI-2026-Applied AI Conference
summary:
As Competency-Based Education (CBE) is gaining traction around the world, the shift from marks-based assessment to qualitative competency mapping is a manual challenge for educators. This paper tackles the bottleneck issue by suggesting a "Human-in-the-Loop" benchmarking framework to assess the effectiveness of multiple LLMs in automating secondary-level mathematics assessment. Based on the Grade 10 Optional Mathematics curriculum in Nepal, we created a multi-dimensional rubric for four topics and four cross-cutting competencies: Comprehension, Knowledge, Operational Fluency, and Behavior and Correlation.
  The multi-provider ensemble, consisted of open-weight models -- Eagle (Llama 3.1-8B) and Orion (Llama 3.3-70B) -- and proprietary frontier models Nova (Gemini 2.5 Flash) and Lyra (Gemini 3 Pro), was benchmarked against a ground truth defined by two senior mathematics faculty members (kappa_w = 0.8652). The findings show a marked "Architecture-compatibility gap". Although the Gemini-based Mixture-of-Experts (Sparse MoE) models achieved "Fair Agreement" (kappa_w ~ 0.38), the larger Orion (70B) model exhibited "No Agreement" (kappa_w = -0.0261), suggesting that architectural compliance with instruction constraints outweighs the scale of raw parameters in rubric-constrained tasks. We conclude that while LLMs are not yet suitable for autonomous certification, they provide high-value assistive support for preliminary evidence extraction within a "Human-in-the-Loop" framework.

title: When to Vote, When to Rewrite: Disagreement-Guided Strategy Routing for Test-Time Scaling
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning tasks but remain unreliable on challenging instances. Existing test-time scaling methods, such as repeated sampling, self-correction, and tree search, improve performance at the cost of increased computation, yet often exhibit diminishing returns on hard problems. We observe that output disagreement is strongly correlated with instance difficulty and prediction correctness, providing a useful signal for guiding instance-level strategy selection at test time. Based on this insight, we propose a training-free framework that formulates test-time scaling as an instance-level routing problem, rather than allocating more computation within a single strategy, dynamically selecting among different scaling strategies based on output disagreement. The framework applies lightweight resolution for consistent cases, majority voting for moderate disagreement, and rewriting-based reformulation for highly ambiguous instances. Experiments on seven mathematical benchmarks and three models show that our method improves accuracy by 3% - 7% while reducing sampling cost compared to existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于输出不一致性（output disagreement）的训练自由框架，将测试时扩展（test-time scaling）建模为实例级路由问题，根据不一致程度动态选择不同策略，在降低采样成本的同时提升数学推理准确率3%-7%。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时扩展方法（重复采样、自我修正、树搜索等）在难题上收益递减，且缺乏针对不同难度实例的自适应策略选择机制。
AI.method: 提出训练自由框架，利用输出不一致性作为实例难度和正确性的信号，将测试时扩展建模为实例级路由问题：对一致案例用轻量级解析，中等不一致用多数投票，高度模糊用重写式重构。
AI.result: 在7个数学基准和3个模型上，相比现有方法，准确率提升3%-7%，同时降低采样成本。
AI.conclusion: 输出不一致性可作为有效的实例级策略选择信号，基于路由的测试时扩展比单一策略扩展更高效。
idea_en: A test-time scaling framework that formulates instance-level routing based on output disagreement, dynamically selecting among different scaling strategies (lightweight resolution, majority voting, rewriting-based reformulation) according to the degree of output disagreement.

A method using output disagreement as a signal to measure instance difficulty and prediction correctness, enabling adaptive allocation of computational resources at test time without additional training.

A disagreement-guided dynamic strategy selection mechanism that assigns light computation for consistent outputs, moderate computation (majority voting) for moderate disagreement, and heavy computation (rewriting-based reformulation) for highly ambiguous instances.

A training-free framework that routes instances to different inference strategies based on output disagreement, improving accuracy while reducing total sampling cost compared to fixed test-time scaling approaches.
idea_ch: 一种基于输出不一致性的测试时扩展框架，将测试时扩展建模为实例级路由问题，根据输出不一致程度动态选择不同扩展策略（轻量级解析、多数投票、重写式重构）。
一种利用输出不一致性作为实例难度和预测正确性信号的方法，无需额外训练即可在测试时自适应分配计算资源。
一种基于不一致性引导的动态策略选择机制：对一致输出分配轻量计算，对中等不一致采用多数投票，对高度模糊案例采用重写式重构。
一种无训练框架，根据输出不一致性将实例路由到不同推理策略，在降低采样成本的同时提升准确率，优于固定的测试时扩展方法。

title: SciHorizon-DataEVA: An Agentic System for AI-Readiness Evaluation of Heterogeneous Scientific Data
summary: AI-for-Science (AI4Science) is increasingly transforming scientific discovery by embedding machine learning models into prediction, simulation, and hypothesis generation workflows across domains. However, the effectiveness of these models is fundamentally constrained by the AI-readiness of scientific data, for which no scalable and systematic evaluation mechanism currently exists. In this work, we propose SciHorizon-DataEVA, a novel agentic system to scalable AI-readiness evaluation of heterogeneous scientific data. At the evaluation-criteria level, we introduce the Sci-TQA2 principles, which organize AI-readiness into four complementary dimensions: Governance Trustworthiness, Data Quality, AI Compatibility, and Scientific Adaptability. Each dimension is decomposed into measurable atomic elements that enable fine-grained and executable assessment. To operationalize these principles at scale, we develop Sci-TQA2-Eval, a hierarchical multi-agent evaluation approach orchestrated through a directed, cyclic workflow. Our Sci-TQA2-Eval dynamically constructs dataset-aware evaluation specifications by combining lightweight dataset profiling, applicability-aware metric activation, and knowledge-augmented planning grounded in domain constraints and dataset-paper signals. These specifications are executed through an adaptive, tool-centric evaluation mechanism with built-in verification and self-correction, enabling scalable and reliable assessment across heterogeneous scientific data. Extensive experiments on scientific datasets spanning multiple domains demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of SciHorizon-DataEVA for principled AI-readiness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciHorizon-DataEVA，一个用于科学数据AI就绪性评估的可扩展代理系统，通过多智能体协作和分层评估框架实现对异构科学数据的系统性评估。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏可扩展且系统化的评估机制来衡量科学数据对AI模型的就绪程度，制约了AI4Science的发展。
AI.method: 提出Sci-TQA2原则（治理可信度、数据质量、AI兼容性、科学适应性四个维度），并构建Sci-TQA2-Eval分层多智能体评估方法，通过轻量级数据画像、适用性感知指标激活、知识增强规划的自适应工作流实现可扩展评估。
AI.result: 在多领域科学数据集上的实验验证了SciHorizon-DataEVA的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次提出了系统化、可扩展的科学数据AI就绪性评估框架，为AI4Science中的数据质量保障提供了标准化解决方案。
idea_en: A hierarchical multi-agent evaluation system (Sci-TQA2-Eval) for assessing AI-readiness of scientific data, comprising a directed cyclic workflow that dynamically constructs dataset-aware evaluation specifications through lightweight dataset profiling.

A four-dimensional evaluation framework (Sci-TQA2 principles) decomposing AI-readiness into Governance Trustworthiness, Data Quality, AI Compatibility, and Scientific Adaptability, each with measurable atomic elements.
An adaptive tool-centric evaluation mechanism with built-in verification and self-correction for heterogeneous scientific data assessment.
A knowledge-augmented planning method that grounds evaluation specifications in domain constraints and dataset-paper signals for context-aware metric activation.
idea_ch: 一种用于科学数据AI就绪性评估的分层多智能体评估系统，通过有向循环工作流，结合轻量级数据画像动态构建数据集感知的评估规范
面向科学数据的四维AI就绪性评估框架（治理可信度、数据质量、AI兼容性、科学适应性），每个维度分解为可量化的原子评估元素
一种自适应、以工具为中心的评估机制，内置验证与自我纠错功能，支持异构科学数据的可靠可扩展评估
一种知识增强的规划方法，利用领域约束和数据集-论文关联信号，实现上下文感知的评估指标动态激活

title: FutureWorld: A Live Environment for Training Predictive Agents with Real-World Outcome Rewards
comment: Our experiments are ongoing, and we will release the code in the near future. We release a subset of our historical data on Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/datasets/PredictingFuture/FutureWorld
summary: Live future prediction refers to the task of making predictions about real-world events before they unfold. This task is increasingly studied using large language model-based agent systems, and it is important for building agents that can continually learn from real-world. Just as interactive environments have often driven progress in agents, advancing live future prediction naturally motivates viewing it as a learning environment. Prior works have explored future prediction from several different parts, but have generally not framed it as a unified learning environment. This task is appealing for learning because it can provide a large number of prediction questions grounded in diverse real-world events, while preventing answer leakage. To leverage the advantages of live future prediction, we present FutureWorld, a live agentic reinforcement learning environment that closes the training loop between prediction, outcome realization, and parameters update. In our environment, we take three open-source base models and train them for consecutive days. The results show that training is effective. Furthermore, we build a daily benchmark based on the environment and evaluate several frontier agents on it to establish performance baselines for current agent systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FutureWorld，一个基于实时未来预测的智能体强化学习环境，通过预测-结果实现-参数更新的闭环训练，提升大语言模型智能体的持续学习能力。
AI.motivation: 现有未来预测研究分散在各子任务中，缺乏统一的标准化学习环境。同时，实时未来预测能为智能体提供大量基于真实世界事件的预测问题，且答案不会提前泄露，非常适合作为持续学习环境。
AI.method: 构建FutureWorld环境，实现"预测→结果验证→参数更新"的闭环训练流程。使用三个开源基础模型进行连续多天的强化学习训练，并基于该环境建立每日基准测试。
AI.result: 实验证明基于FutureWorld的训练方法有效，并建立了当前前沿智能体的性能基线。
AI.conclusion: FutureWorld为实时预测任务提供了统一的学习环境，验证了闭环训练的有效性，为构建能从真实世界持续学习的智能体提供了新范式。
idea_en: A live agentic reinforcement learning environment (FutureWorld) that closes the training loop between prediction, outcome realization, and parameter updates for LLM-based agents.
A method for training open-source base models using consecutive days of real-world live prediction data in a reinforcement learning framework.
A daily benchmark system built on live future prediction events that prevents answer leakage while providing grounded real-world evaluation.
idea_ch: 一种实时智能体强化学习环境FutureWorld，实现了大语言模型智能体在预测、结果实现与参数更新之间的闭环训练
利用连续多天的真实世界实时预测数据对开源基础模型进行强化学习训练的方法
基于实时未来预测事件的日度基准测试系统，能够防止答案泄露并提供基于真实世界的评估

title: Bian Que: An Agentic Framework with Flexible Skill Arrangement for Online System Operations
summary: Operating and maintaining (O&M) large-scale online engine systems (search, recommendation, advertising) demands substantial human effort for release monitoring, alert response, and root cause analysis. While LLM-based agents are a natural fit for these tasks, the deployment bottleneck is not reasoning capability but orchestration: selecting, for each operational event, the relevant data (metrics, logs, change events) and the applicable operational knowledge (handbook rules and practitioner experience). Feeding all signals indiscriminately causes dilution and hallucination, while manually curating the event-to-(data, knowledge) mapping is intractable under dozens of daily releases. We present Bian Que, an agentic framework with three contributions: (i) a \emph{unified operational paradigm} abstracting day-to-day O&M into three canonical patterns: release interception, proactive inspection, and alert root cause analysis; (ii) \emph{Flexible Skill Arrangement}, where each Skill specifies which data and knowledge to retrieve for a given business-module context and can be automatically generated and updated by LLMs or iteratively refined through natural-language instructions from on-call engineers; (iii) a \emph{unified self-evolving mechanism} in which one correction signal drives two parallel pathways, case-memory-to-knowledge distillation and targeted Skill refinement. Deployed on the e-commerce search engine of KuaiShou, the major short-video platform in China, Bian Que reduces alert volume by 75%, achieves 80% root-cause analysis accuracy, and cuts mean time to resolution by over 50%. Our framework achieves 99.0% pass rate on offline evaluations. Our code is available at https://github.com/benchen4395/BianQue_Assistant.

AI.tldr: Bian Que是一个面向大规模在线引擎系统（搜索、推荐、广告）运维的智能体框架，通过统一运维范式、灵活技能编排和自进化机制，在快手电商搜索引擎上实现告警量减少75%、根因分析准确率80%、平均解决时间缩短50%以上。
AI.motivation: 大规模在线引擎系统的运维依赖大量人力进行发布监控、告警响应和根因分析。虽然LLM智能体适合这些任务，但部署瓶颈不是推理能力，而是编排问题——如何为每个运维事件选择相关数据和知识。全量输入会导致信息稀释和幻觉，手动编排又不可行。
AI.method: 1) 统一运维范式：将日常运维抽象为三类典型模式——发布拦截、主动巡检、告警根因分析。2) 灵活技能编排(Flexible Skill Arrangement)：每个Skill指定在给定业务模块上下文中应检索哪些数据和知识，可由LLM自动生成更新或由值班工程师通过自然语言迭代优化。3) 统一自进化机制：一个修正信号驱动两条并行路径——案例记忆到知识蒸馏和定向Skill优化。
AI.result: 在快手电商搜索引擎部署后，告警量减少75%，根因分析准确率达80%，平均解决时间缩短50%以上。离线评估通过率达99.0%。
AI.conclusion: Bian Que通过统一运维范式、灵活技能编排和自进化机制，有效解决了LLM智能体在运维场景中的编排瓶颈问题，显著提升了大规模在线系统的运维效率。
idea_en: A unified operational paradigm that abstracts daily O&M of large-scale online engine systems into three canonical patterns: release interception, proactive inspection, and alert root cause analysis, enabling systematic event-to-data/knowledge mapping.

Flexible Skill Arrangement mechanism where each Skill specifies which data and knowledge to retrieve for a given business-module context, and Skills can be automatically generated/updated by LLMs or iteratively refined through natural-language instructions from on-call engineers.

A unified self-evolving mechanism where a single correction signal drives two parallel pathways: case-memory-to-knowledge distillation and targeted Skill refinement, enabling continuous improvement without manual intervention.

An agentic framework for O&M that dynamically selects relevant monitoring metrics, logs, change events, and operational knowledge for each operational event, preventing information dilution and hallucination caused by indiscriminate data feeding.
idea_ch: 一种统一运维范式，将大规模在线引擎系统的日常运维抽象为三类规范模式：发布拦截、主动巡检和告警根因分析，实现事件到数据/知识的系统性映射。
灵活技能编排机制，每个Skill规定在给定业务模块上下文中应检索哪些数据和知识，Skill可由LLM自动生成/更新或由值班工程师通过自然语言指令迭代优化。
统一自进化机制，单个修正信号驱动两条并行路径：案例记忆到知识蒸馏和定向Skill优化，实现无需人工干预的持续改进。
一种面向运维的智能体框架，为每个运维事件动态选择相关的监控指标、日志、变更事件和运维知识，防止无差别数据输入导致的信息稀释和幻觉问题。
